A '''Sound Generation Module''' was a component used in [[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited]]'s [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]]. The Module was located at the rear of the weapon, close to the [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] and the integrated [[Stun club/Legends|stun club]].<ref name="EGWT" />
